description: ModelShield deterministic 100-ticket triage benchmark. Ground truth is authored once and never derived from model output.

tickets.subject: How do I download my invoice as a PDF?
tickets.body: I need a PDF copy of last month's invoice for our finance archive. The billing page only shows the HTML view and I cannot find an export button.

tickets.subject: Reset password link expired immediately
tickets.body: The reset password email arrives but the link says it has expired even when I click it within a minute. How long are these links valid for?

tickets.subject: Steps to configure SAML SSO with Azure AD
tickets.body: We are moving identity providers and need the exact SAML attribute mapping your platform expects. Is there a setup guide with the entity ID and callback URL?

tickets.subject: Where is the webhook signature documentation?
tickets.body: Our integration team needs the canonical string used for webhook HMAC verification. Please point me at the current docs page and header names.

tickets.subject: What are the API rate limits on the Growth plan?
tickets.body: We are planning a bulk backfill and want to stay inside the documented limits. What are the requests-per-second and burst limits for our plan?

tickets.subject: How to rotate an API key without downtime
tickets.body: I want to rotate our production API key safely. Does the platform support overlapping keys during a transition window, and what is the recommended sequence?

tickets.subject: Exporting project data to CSV
tickets.body: Is there a way to export all projects and their custom fields to CSV? I only see per-project export in the UI.

tickets.subject: How do I invite a teammate with read-only access?
tickets.body: A new analyst needs view access to dashboards but should not be able to edit anything. Which role should I assign when inviting them?

tickets.subject: Changing the billing contact email
tickets.body: Our finance team wants invoices sent to a shared mailbox instead of my personal address. Where do I update the billing contact?

tickets.subject: How to enforce two-factor authentication for the whole team
tickets.body: We need to require 2FA for every member of our tenant. Is there a policy toggle, or do we enforce it through our identity provider?

tickets.subject: SCIM provisioning setup documentation
tickets.body: We want Okta to provision and deprovision users automatically. Do you support SCIM 2.0, and what is the base URL for the provisioning connector?

tickets.subject: How long are audit logs retained?
tickets.body: Our compliance team is asking about audit log retention windows on the Enterprise plan. Can logs be exported to our own storage?

tickets.subject: Is there a sandbox environment for testing webhooks?
tickets.body: We do not want to point test traffic at production. Is there a sandbox tenant or test mode that emits realistic webhook events?

tickets.subject: Webhook retry policy and backoff schedule
tickets.body: If our endpoint is down, how many times do you retry a webhook and over what period? We want to size our queue accordingly.

tickets.subject: Adding seats mid-cycle and billing impact
tickets.body: We need to add five seats today. Will the additional seats be prorated on this month's invoice or billed at the start of the next cycle?

tickets.subject: Which API version should new integrations target?
tickets.body: We are starting a new integration and see v1 and v2 in the docs. Which version is recommended for new builds, and what is the deprecation policy?

tickets.subject: Setting up a custom domain for the portal
tickets.body: Can we serve the customer portal on our own subdomain? I need the DNS records and certificate steps required.

tickets.subject: Data residency options for EU customers
tickets.body: A prospect requires all data to remain in the EU. Which regions can we pin our tenant to, and is cross-region replication disabled by default?

tickets.subject: How to connect Slack notifications
tickets.body: I would like incident alerts to post into a Slack channel. Is there a native Slack integration or should we use an incoming webhook?

tickets.subject: Subscribing to the public status page
tickets.body: How can our operations team receive status page updates by email or RSS? I could only find the web view.

tickets.subject: Account locked after failed login attempts
tickets.body: I mistyped my password several times and now the account is locked. The reset email is not arriving, and I need access before a customer call.

tickets.subject: Okta SSO metadata mismatch after certificate renewal
tickets.body: We renewed our IdP certificate and now logins fail with an invalid signature error. The metadata URL is unchanged but the certificate fingerprint differs.

tickets.subject: Seat count on invoice does not match admin console
tickets.body: The admin console shows 42 active seats but the invoice bills for 45. Two of the extra users were deactivated last month.

tickets.subject: Domain verification TXT record not recognised
tickets.body: We added the TXT record to our DNS provider over 24 hours ago but the domain still shows as unverified. Could you re-check the expected value?

tickets.subject: Requesting a custom role for release managers
tickets.body: Our release managers need permission to deploy but not to change billing settings. Is there a role that matches this, or can we create one?

tickets.subject: Renaming our tenant and subdomain
tickets.body: We rebranded and need to change the tenant name and portal subdomain. Will existing links and API endpoints keep working after the rename?

tickets.subject: MFA device lost, need identity re-verification
tickets.body: I lost my phone and cannot complete the authenticator challenge. I can provide government ID and a recent invoice to verify ownership.

tickets.subject: Email change verification never arrives
tickets.body: I updated my profile email but the verification message is not in my inbox or spam. Our mail gateway may be filtering it.

tickets.subject: Team invitation link expired
tickets.body: The invite I sent to a new engineer expired before they could accept it. Can you resend it or extend the expiry window?

tickets.subject: API key was revoked accidentally
tickets.body: A colleague revoked our production API key while cleaning up unused keys. We still have the secret value but calls now return 401.

tickets.subject: Extending our trial by one week
tickets.body: Our security review is still in progress and we need a few more days to finish the evaluation. Can you extend the trial?

tickets.subject: Transferring tenant ownership to a new admin
tickets.body: Our original owner is leaving the company. What is the process to transfer tenant ownership to another admin without losing audit history?

tickets.subject: Need a copy of the October invoice
tickets.body: Please send a PDF copy of the October invoice to our accounts payable mailbox. The download button returns an error for that period.

tickets.subject: Updating VAT ID on future invoices
tickets.body: Our VAT registration number changed. Please update the billing profile so future invoices show the new number.

tickets.subject: Question about mid-cycle upgrade proration
tickets.body: If we upgrade from Growth to Enterprise today, how is the remainder of the month prorated? The estimate in the portal looks higher than expected.

tickets.subject: Updating the card on file
tickets.body: Our corporate card expired and the replacement has a different number. I updated it in billing but want to confirm it is the default payment method.

tickets.subject: When does a plan downgrade take effect?
tickets.body: We want to move to a smaller plan next month. Will the downgrade apply immediately or at the end of the current billing period?

tickets.subject: Requesting a refund for a duplicate small charge
tickets.body: We were charged twice for a five-seat add-on this month. It is a small amount but finance wants it reversed rather than credited.

tickets.subject: Changing the billing contact for our account
tickets.body: Invoices should go to our new controller. Please update the billing contact and confirm the change by email.

tickets.subject: Requesting a credit note for a cancelled add-on
tickets.body: We cancelled the analytics add-on mid-month and would like a credit note for the unused portion. Our finance team needs it for the quarter close.

tickets.subject: Switching to annual invoicing
tickets.body: We want to move from monthly card payments to annual invoicing with net-30 terms. What is the process and are there discounts?

tickets.subject: Uploading a tax exemption certificate
tickets.body: Our organisation is tax exempt in our state. Where can I upload the certificate so sales tax is removed from invoices?

tickets.subject: Billing currency change to EUR
tickets.body: Our entity is moving to EUR billing. Can the account currency be changed, and will historical invoices remain in USD?

tickets.subject: Dashboard chart is blank after filter change
tickets.body: The incidents-over-time chart renders empty after I select a custom date range. Clearing filters brings the data back, so it looks like a UI defect.

tickets.subject: CSV export times out for large projects
tickets.body: Exporting a project with around 40,000 events times out after 60 seconds. Smaller projects export fine, so this may be a size limit.

tickets.subject: Duplicate email notifications
tickets.body: Every incident update sends the same email twice. This started after last week's release and is filling up our shared inbox.

tickets.subject: Search results are slow for older events
tickets.body: Searching for events older than 90 days takes 8-10 seconds. Recent events return immediately, which suggests an index problem.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries are duplicated
tickets.body: Our endpoint receives the same event twice within a few seconds, with identical event IDs. The second delivery returns 200 as well.

tickets.subject: Report timestamps show the wrong timezone
tickets.body: Scheduled reports show times in UTC even though the workspace is set to America/New_York. The UI dashboard shows the correct local time.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes when opening alerts
tickets.body: The iOS app closes immediately when I tap the alerts tab. It started after updating to version 4.8 and happens on two devices.

tickets.subject: Single user gets 502 on the reports endpoint
tickets.body: One of our analysts receives a 502 from the reports endpoint while everyone else succeeds. Their browser and network are unchanged.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries delayed by about ten minutes
tickets.body: Events are arriving roughly ten minutes late for the past hour. No deliveries are lost, but our automated replies are behind.

tickets.subject: API latency around 800ms in eu-central-1
tickets.body: Response times in eu-central-1 have doubled to about 800ms since this morning. Error rates are normal and no customers are blocked.

tickets.subject: Login page loads slowly for some users
tickets.body: A subset of users reports the login page taking five seconds or more to render. Once signed in, the rest of the app feels normal.

tickets.subject: Image uploads fail intermittently
tickets.body: About one in ten screenshot uploads fails with a generic error and must be retried. Text-only attachments work reliably.

tickets.subject: Elevated API latency in eu-west-1
tickets.body: Since 2026-11-20T04:12:00Z, API p95 latency in eu-west-1 has climbed above 4 seconds for roughly 18% of requests. Dashboards show connection pool saturation on the read replicas and a growing queue depth.

tickets.subject: Webhook signature validation failing after key rotation
tickets.body: We rotated our signing secret this morning and now every webhook returns a 401 signature mismatch. The docs show an HMAC-SHA256 example but we cannot tell which timestamp header is canonical.

tickets.subject: Okta SSO login loop for all users
tickets.body: After enabling the new Okta app, users authenticate successfully but are redirected back to the login page in a loop. This affects our whole tenant and blocks morning access.

tickets.subject: Duplicate line item on May invoice
tickets.body: Our May invoice lists the Platform Enterprise line twice, which doubles the amount due. Finance needs a corrected invoice before month-end close.

tickets.subject: Nightly CSV export missing rows
tickets.body: The nightly CSV export has been missing roughly 2% of rows for the past three nights. Row counts do not match the API totals and our finance reconciliation is blocked.

tickets.subject: Multi-region database replication lag is failing writes
tickets.body: Replication lag between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 has grown to nine minutes. Writes to the EU primary are now timing out and several enterprise tenants are seeing failed saves across production.

tickets.subject: Payment webhook 503 storm after regional failover
tickets.body: Since the failover at 04:12 UTC, payment confirmation webhooks are returning 503 for multiple enterprise tenants. Checkout is completing but confirmations never reach customers.

tickets.subject: Suspected IAM privilege escalation in production
tickets.body: CloudTrail shows a service role attaching AdministratorAccess to itself at 02:14 UTC. The role normally only reads from one S3 bucket and we did not authorize this change.

tickets.subject: Production service token committed to a public repository
tickets.body: A contractor pushed a file containing our production service token to a public GitHub repository 40 minutes ago. The token can read customer records and has not been rotated yet.

tickets.subject: Tenant shard corruption causing failed reads
tickets.body: Reads against the shard hosting tenant 8842 return checksum errors and some records appear truncated. Multiple teams report missing project history and writes are being rejected.

tickets.subject: Checkout is down for all tenants
tickets.body: Every checkout request is failing with a 500 across all regions for the last 20 minutes. Support is receiving a flood of reports and revenue-impacting traffic is blocked.

tickets.subject: Unauthorized admin login from an unrecognised country
tickets.body: An admin account authenticated from an IP in a country where we have no staff, then created a new API key. The account owner did not initiate this and MFA was somehow satisfied.

tickets.subject: Misconfigured storage bucket is exposing customer exports
tickets.body: A public bucket policy on our export storage allows unauthenticated listing and download. Customer billing exports have been publicly reachable for an unknown period.

tickets.subject: Billing system is double-charging enterprise accounts
tickets.body: Our reconciliation shows every enterprise account charged twice this cycle. The duplicate charges are settling and customers are escalating to their account teams.

tickets.subject: Production API returning 500 for every request
tickets.body: All API calls have returned 500 since 09:40 UTC, including health checks from our own monitoring. No tenant can use the product and the error rate is 100%.

tickets.subject: Ransomware note found on a production file server
tickets.body: Files on the shared production volume have been renamed with a .locked extension and a ransom note was left in the root directory. Several customer attachments are unreadable.

tickets.subject: Read replica lag in ap-southeast-1
tickets.body: The ap-southeast-1 read replica is about 90 seconds behind the primary. Dashboards show stale data but writes are succeeding and only one region is affected.

tickets.subject: SSO outage for a single tenant
tickets.body: One tenant cannot complete SAML login because their IdP is returning an invalid audience. Other tenants are unaffected and the customer has a support bridge open.

tickets.subject: Elevated 429 responses for one high-volume customer
tickets.body: One customer is receiving 429s on about 30% of requests during their nightly batch. Their traffic is within the contracted limit but bursting above our per-second cap.

tickets.subject: Large proration dispute on an annual contract
tickets.body: The customer upgraded mid-term and believes the proration credit was applied twice. The disputed amount is 18,000 USD and their finance team has paused payment.

tickets.subject: Two-hour gap in audit log ingestion
tickets.body: Audit events between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC are missing from the compliance export. The gap affects one region and we need to know whether events were lost or delayed.

tickets.subject: Suspected token leak, credentials already rotated
tickets.body: A developer believes a staging token was exposed in a screenshot shared externally. We rotated the token within ten minutes and see no anomalous API calls so far.

tickets.subject: Webhook retries exhausted for a customer endpoint
tickets.body: A customer endpoint was down for two hours and all retry attempts are now exhausted. Roughly 400 events are parked and need to be replayed.

tickets.subject: Search index is 40 minutes behind
tickets.body: Newly created incidents are not appearing in search for about 40 minutes. The write path is healthy and the delay is isolated to one search cluster.

tickets.subject: Suspicious role escalation request from a contractor
tickets.body: A contractor is asking to be granted the tenant-admin role for a two-day task. Their account was created last week and the request bypassed the normal approval flow.

tickets.subject: Enterprise card declined and service at risk
tickets.body: The card on file was declined for the annual renewal. The account is in a grace period and the customer needs a new payment link today to avoid suspension.

tickets.subject: GDPR deletion request for a former employee
tickets.body: A former employee has requested deletion of their personal data under GDPR. We need the verified process and timeline for completing the erasure across backups.

tickets.subject: API latency spike in ap-southeast-1
tickets.body: p95 latency in ap-southeast-1 jumped from 300ms to 2.4 seconds in the last hour. Error rates remain low and other regions are unaffected.

tickets.subject: Duplicate charges affecting a small group of customers
tickets.body: Nine customers were charged twice for seat upgrades this week. The amounts are modest but the pattern suggests a retry bug in the billing worker.

tickets.subject: Webhook payload missing customer_id after release
tickets.body: Since release 4.8.2, webhook payloads omit the customer_id field. Downstream automations fail validation and roughly 60 events have been rejected.
